scope: Personal Zero2Fit workout generation for a healthy adult starting from a low training baseline. These are planning defaults, not medical advice or a diagnosis-specific prescription.

evidence.name: ACSM 2026 Resistance Training Position Stand
evidence.summary: Progressive resistance training improves strength, hypertrophy and physical function. High-effort resistance training at least twice weekly engaging all major muscle groups is the primary recommendation; home-based and bodyweight resistance training are effective options.

evidence.name: CDC Adult Physical Activity Guidelines
evidence.summary: Adults should work toward at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity per week plus muscle-strengthening activity on at least 2 days per week.

foundationPhase.progressionRule: When the top of the assigned rep range is completed with controlled form in two consecutive exposures, advance one small step: add repetitions first when load is fixed; otherwise add the smallest practical load and return to the lower end of the rep range.
foundationPhase.notes: Advanced techniques are not required for the Foundation phase. The planner should prefer exercises that are simple to execute and easy to progress.
